svg.title: Figure AB-2. Air brake check flow (psi numbers)
svg.desc: Numbers from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) sections 5.1.11, 5.2.1, 5.3.3 and DL 650 X (applied leakage, low-air, pop-out). Use the manufacturer's values when posted on the vehicle.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure AB-2. Air brake check flow (psi numbers)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: Engine at idle. Dual systems: build about 85 to 100 psi within 45 seconds. Governor cut-out usually 120-140
psi (about 125 psi). Identify when cut-out occurs.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: At cut-out, shut off engine, release parking (and tractor protection on a combination), fully apply the foot
brake, wait for the gauge to settle, then hold 1 minute. Max drop: 3 psi single, 4 psi combination of 2, 6

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: Fan the foot valve from a charged system. Warning light/buzzer (and wig-wag if equipped) must come on before
pressure drops below 55 psi, typically in the 55-75 psi range.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: Continue fanning. Normally between 20 and 45 psi the parking valve (and tractor protection on a
tractor-trailer) should pop out and the spring brakes come on.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: Static leakage (brakes released): 2 / 3 / 5 psi per minute (single / 2-vehicle / 3+). In-cab: parking-brake
tug test and a rolling service-brake stop. If the low-air warning comes on while driving, stop safely right

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Numbers from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) sections 5.1.11, 5.2.1, 5.3.3 and DL 650 X (applied leakage, low-air, pop-out). Use the manufacturer's values when posted on the vehicle.
